name: closing-draw-only-v1
description: ⭐ DECOMPOSITION ARM 3 OF 3 (14/09/2026): THE CLOSING DRAW ALONE, on the reference-v18 game. Its CONTROL is overlays/pre-delivery-meeple-v1.overlay.json and it differs from it in ONE leaf, rules.turn.closingDrawPerCrate 1: the delivery that fills a tile's last free space draws one card for each crate token on the tile from that token's suit, a cornucopia from any deck in play at the closer's choice (Dean), and a crate turned face down by V6 from its PRINTED suit (a builder default, not ruled). The meeple is pinned OFF by name at its pre-ruling values (deliveryMeepleSpace null, meepleSpendTiming 'start', meepleSpendPerTurn null, meepleSpendDistinctColours false) and rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice false, so the closer is always the second arrival. ⛔ PASSENGERS, NAMED: none beyond the base; everything else is the shipped reference-v18 game. Its siblings are overlays/delivery-meeple-no-choice-v1.overlay.json and overlays/delivery-meeple-choice-v1.overlay.json. ⚠️ HOW TO RUN IT: --overlay= with --watchlist, never --sweep=, and always --n=1580 (4,820 games, five mirrors), paired on identical reference-v18 seeds. A bare --watchlist is a 1,580-game pilot and must not be quoted beside a real run.
